name: phil/ddd-bundle
description: The few types every bounded context of a Symfony application shares: identifiers, domain events, domain errors, and command and query buses on Messenger.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To store identifiers in a native uuid column, or BINARY(16) where the platform has none, through Infrastructure\Doctrine\IdentifierType
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: To turn a route placeholder into the identifier class a controller argument declares, through Infrastructure\HttpKernel\IdentifierValueResolver
suggest.symfony/maker-bundle: For the make:ddd:context, make:ddd:identifier, make:ddd:command, make:ddd:query and make:ddd:event commands
suggest.symfony/serializer: To serialise identifiers as their canonical string and build them back, through Infrastructure\Serializer\IdentifierNormalizer
